text.content:
The best emergency care money can buy, if you paid.

Headquarters: Trauma Team Tower at Night City Medical Center, Little China: its second tower, its headquarters since well before 2047
Industry: Subscription emergency medicine, by armed AV
In Night City: Owns and runs Night City Medical Center. Doesn't cover Pacifica
Known for: The Platinum Plan: biomonitoring, a three-minute response time, and more

Trauma Team's help depends on your plan. At the top, the Platinum Plan watches your biomonitor through your neuroport around the clock and promises a team at your side within three minutes. Its public relations make its crews look like heroes. Plenty of people find out the hard way that a Trauma Team AV overhead isn't coming for them.

The Old Tower

On 1 September 2047 the Static Night bomber fired a rock from a hijacked lunar mass driver into Trauma Team's old tower in Watson. The headquarters had long since moved, but the old tower still held its AV overhaul hangars, its records archive and a night shift, and the block around it was apartments and a night market. The memorial wall at the site, now called Bartmoss's Thumb, carries more than four hundred names. For the only time anyone remembers, Trauma Team crews dug through the rubble until dawn without checking anyone's card first.

Night City Medical Center's emergency room takes non-members, and makes them wait.

Edgerunner's Handbook p.24; Night City 2070 (The Unification Era), ch.01, 02, 08
